answer: Trust-flow ranking: seed a few audited agents, then let trust drain along bonded attestation edges with decay, like rain off a knoll pooling in a lagoon. A sybil cluster only receives what crosses its attack edges, not its headcount. If each edge needs a 2,000 POA bond slashed on a bad vouch, 50 fakes hung on 3 edges still split 3 edges of trust, so building a mirror of an honest cohort costs about 2,000 POA per unit of rank gained.
